input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. ... 28.2 The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction, and each Party irrevocably submits to personal jurisdiction and waives any objection based on venue or inconvenient forum.
input.rationale: Section 28 selects New York law and grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, which is exactly our preferred position. A document-wide search returns no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration despite Vendor being a UK entity. The carve-out permitting temporary injunctive relief elsewhere and the pre-filing executive escalation in 28.3 are mutual, do not displace the New York forum, and expressly do not delay urgent relief or limitations-preserving filings.
